newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Gambro says gets no patent for BiCart.
newsitem.headline: Gambro says gets no patent for BiCart.

text.p: Swedish investment company Incentive said on Wednesday that its main subsidiary, medical technology company Gambro, was not granted a patent for the BiCart bicarbonate cartridge by the European Patent Office.

"While I regret the decision, I would like to emphasise that it does not affect Gambro's future prospects in the market for dialysis concentrates," Gambro president Berthold Lindqvist said in a statement.

"Our stable position on the concentrate market is based on a number of key factors, such as our market leadership, our cost-efficient production of BiCart and the fact that our extensive equipment base in adepted to BiCart."
Gambro is planning to introduce additional products within the same system, he added.
